run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the difference between highest and least element frequencies in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets and print success count
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which sorts an array and counts consecutive duplicate frequencies to find their difference
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like single-element arrays or arrays with all unique elements
